item.title: New species of chicken-sized dinosaur in Spain is changing the history of evolution
item.description: Our understanding of dinosaurs has changed over time. The “thunder lizards” are considered to be more related to birds than we previously thought. item.title: New Arctic fossils could be the ancestor of all creatures that have jaws
item.description: Here’s some science news to chew on: the reason humans and other animals have jaws may have been revealed thanks to a recent fossil discovery. In the Arctic, a fossilized fish species has been found to have teeth on the bony plates lining the roof of its mouth.
